transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I came in because I’ve been having thoughts that my family might be better off if I didn’t wake up. That scared me, so I told my supervisor, and they said I should come in and talk to someone.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things the way you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah… I have. I used to like messing with my tomato plants, sanding wood out at my bench, watching the Falcons, staying after church and talking with folks. Lately I just look at all that like it belongs to somebody else. I don’t feel much pull toward any of it.
Have you ever felt this way before, where you didn’t take pleasure in things and had thoughts about not wanting to wake up?
Yeah… I have felt low like this before. Looking back, these down stretches have been coming and going for maybe about a year. But this one, after my daughter left, it’s been the hardest one.
Before this current episode, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of at least two weeks?
Yes. Looking back, I think these low stretches have been coming on and off for about a year now. This one since my daughter left has been the worst, but it wasn’t the first time I felt that way.
Between these low periods, have you had times where you felt back to your normal self, or have the feelings of depression been pretty much constant over the past year?

It hasn’t been constant the whole year, no. It comes in stretches. I’ve had times in between where I felt more like myself, but then it comes back. This one after my daughter left… that’s the one that’s hit me the hardest.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or irritable, where you didn’t need much sleep or felt like you could take on the world?

Yeah… before this low spell, I did have times where I felt really fired up, like everything was finally going my way. And other times I was just more irritable, snapping at people over little things I normally wouldn’t care about.
When you felt that unusually high mood or irritability, did it last for at least a week or more, or was it something that came and went more quickly?

It wasn’t like a whole week straight, I don’t think. It would come in spells before this low hit — I’d feel way too fired up, like things were finally going my way, or I’d get real irritable and snap at people over little stuff I’d usually let go.

Have you ever had a period where your mood was so high or you were so full of energy that it led to problems in your life, like getting into arguments, spending too much money, or doing things that weren’t like you?

Yeah… I did spend money I shouldn’t have. I got it in my head to buy these expensive old motorcycle parts, put them on credit like it was nothing. At the time it felt fine, like I’d deal with it later. Then later I saw the bills and thought, what in the world was I thinking?
Before the episode that started after your daughter left, have you had at least one other period of depression that lasted for two weeks or more?
Yeah… looking back, I think I have. The low stretches have been coming around for about a year now, on and off, but the one after my daughter left has definitely been the hardest.
